usedFor: EventBrite holds events, orders and attendees, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computers through “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendee Check -In” in EventBrite, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A check-in is a live moment at the door, so the command runs on your computer right then.

watchOut: “New Attendee Updated” in EventBrite fires when an attendee orders a ticket, so read its description before picking it.
